title: More children, shorter paths
hook: More children change the shape and the work of a heap.

knows: Compare numbers; read a short array, string, tree or graph as drawn.
Heap parent/child ordering and priority comparisons.
doesNotKnow: Compare d-ary heap extraction depth against child-comparison cost.

misconception: More children always make a priority queue faster.
objective: Compare d-ary heap extraction depth against child-comparison cost.

claims.text: The arity determines how many children compete at each downward step. More children can shorten the path while increasing comparisons per level; the two computed traces show the tradeoff on the same keys.
